caption: The drawing depicts a single blue glass vase centered on a plain, light beige background. The vase has a wide, rounded body that tapers into a narrow neck, which then flares outward at the rim. The base of the vase is circular and wide, supporting a short stem that connects to the main body. The blue glass is shaded to indicate its transparency and reflective qualities, with highlights and darker areas suggesting light source and curvature. There are no additional objects or decorative elements in the image, and the overall composition is simple, focusing solely on the vase.
title: Vase
